classification.difficultyReason: Find the width by scaling the width-to-length ratio, then use that result with the given length in the rectangle perimeter formula; the two parts explicitly scaffold the sequence.

content.prompt: In a rectangle, the ratio of the width to the length is $5:12$. The length is 48 cm.

questionDiagrams.alt: Rectangle with 48\text{ cm} and w; w:l=5:12

spec.description: Unshaded rectangle with the given measurements, unknown side and ratio; not to scale.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the width of the rectangle.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}12\text{ parts}&=48\text{ cm}\\1\text{ part}&=48\div12=4\text{ cm}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times4=20\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the perimeter of the rectangle.
